      <p class="ws-sub">A one-page baseline map of our current agentic SDLC coverage across all eight phases, with named owners and evidenced gaps.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-04-lifecycle-layer-coverage-canvas</b><br>

    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch04-the-reference-architecture.html#sec-ref-arch-lifecycle-mapping">#sec-ref-arch-lifecycle-mapping</a>
    &middot; &ldquo;The three layers apply at every phase of software delivery&rdquo;
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    For each of the eight lifecycle phases, name the human who is accountable, mark the agent capability you actually use today
    (none, pilot or production), name the platform systems behind it, tick where you are now (Automated, Assisted or Manual),
    and write the gap in one line. Where nobody owns a phase, write <b>unowned</b> &mdash; that is the finding. Any tick above
    Manual needs the tool, pipeline or workflow that justifies it in column 10. Then set your 6- and 12-month targets.
    The grey columns are the book's; compare yours against them, and do not write in them.
  </div>

    <div class="prior" style="margin-top:2mm;font-size:7.5pt">
      <b>Key to column 11 &mdash; maturity tiers.</b>
      <b>Now</b> = available across two or more vendors. <b>Emerging</b> = available in one or two tools, or in limited preview.
      <b>Directional</b> = announced, demonstrated or on public roadmaps but not production-ready.
      These are statements about what vendors can deliver, not a maturity target. A phase tagged Directional where you are Manual is not a gap &mdash; it is the market.

      <colgroup><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:25%"><col style="width:16.7%"><col style="width:16.7%"><col style="width:16.6%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th>Bucket</th><th>Phases, per the book</th><th>Manual</th><th>Assisted</th><th>Automated</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">23</span></td><td class="prior"><b>INTENT</b><span class="prior-src">ch04 L81; ch02 L189-191</span></td><td class="prior">Ideate, Plan</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Manual in column 9, Ideate + Plan"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Assisted in column 9, Ideate + Plan"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Automated in column 9, Ideate + Plan"></span></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">24</span></td><td class="prior"><b>BUILD</b><span class="prior-src">ch04 L81; ch02 L189-191</span></td><td class="prior">Code, Build, Test, Review</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Manual in column 9, Code + Build + Test + Review"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Assisted in column 9, Code + Build + Test + Review"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Automated in column 9, Code + Build + Test + Review"></span></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">25</span></td><td class="prior"><b>OPERATE</b><span class="prior-src">ch04 L81; ch02 L189-191</span></td><td class="prior">Release, Operate</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Manual in column 9, Release + Operate"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count of Assisted in column 9, Release + Operate"></span></td>
